dct_title_s: Isaac Lake Quadrangle, Minnesota-St. Louis County, 1949: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Isaac Lake quadrangle topographic map (N4737.5-W9200/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in pencil, red and black ink regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area between Babbitt and Embarrass. The hand written notations include information on the following logging camps noted with 'C'.
